agentClaim.summary: Red-team of commit 802a0965 (R3-P1 remote projector/presenter). All four named attacks failed to break the implementation: (1) present_remote_outcome maps a failed BuildShowOutcome downcast to GatewayError::unexpected via ok_or_else — no unwrap/expect/panic on that path; (2) ProviderError maps to at least four distinct ErrorCategory values (Precondition / Conflict / Validation / Unexpected), not a silent Unexpected collapse; (3) include_runtime is a struct-literal true with no caller parameter and no other construction site; (4) cargo metadata shows herdr-fgos is not a root workspace member; cargo pkgid -p fgos and -p fgos-host-runtime still resolve to apps/fgos and packages/host-runtime/rust, and -p herdr-fgos from repo root still fails. Two LOW proof-sufficiency findings: FOCUSED_TESTS never construct a Completed payload that is not BuildShowOutcome, and they never inspect root workspace resolution.

findings.title: FOCUSED_TESTS miss the downcast-failure contract present_remote_outcome claims
findings.detail: present_remote_outcome is specified to return a mapped GatewayError when ProviderOutcome::Completed.output is not BuildShowOutcome, and the source does that (ok_or_else -> GatewayError::unexpected("unsupported outcome payload type")). Named attack (1) therefore does not break the code. FOCUSED_TESTS still never construct that case: test_present_remote_outcome_completed uses a real BuildShowOutcome, test_present_remote_outcome_parked_fallback uses Parked, and test_present_remote_outcome_error_mappings only feeds ProviderError. A future regression to .unwrap()/.expect() on downcast_ref would still go green under `cargo test --manifest-path herdr-plugin/Cargo.toml remote_invocation`.
findings.evidence: herdr-plugin/src/remote_invocation.rs:206-213 (mapped error), 267-316 (Completed+Parked tests), 317-382 (error tests; no wrong-type Completed)

findings.title: FOCUSED_TESTS miss the workspace-isolation contract the Cargo.toml path deps change
findings.detail: The diff adds path deps on fgos-host-runtime and fgos-distribution to an excluded crate. Named attack (4) does not land: independent `cargo metadata --no-deps` from repo root still has exactly the five original workspace members and zero herdr packages; `cargo pkgid -p fgos` / `-p fgos-host-runtime` still resolve to apps/fgos and packages/host-runtime/rust; `cargo pkgid -p herdr-fgos` from root still exits 101. FOCUSED_TESTS (`cargo test --manifest-path herdr-plugin/Cargo.toml remote_invocation`) cannot observe any of that — they only compile the excluded crate's own graph. A members-list addition in root Cargo.toml would not fail that filter.
findings.evidence: cargo metadata --no-deps (root workspace_members=5, no herdr); cargo pkgid -p fgos / fgos-host-runtime / herdr-fgos; git show 802a0965 --stat (root Cargo.toml untouched)
